user.description: Connect to your drauf instance. Create an API token with the plan:read scope in drauf under Settings → API tokens.

data_description.url: The address of your drauf server, for example drauf.example.com
data_description.api_token: A token with the plan:read scope (starts with drauf_)

reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {url} was rejected. Enter a new token with the plan:read scope.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect — check the instance URL
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected — check it has the plan:read scope

abort.already_configured: This drauf instance is already configured

get_plan.name: Get plan
get_plan.description: Returns all plan entries in a date range, grouped by date, with slot, link, image, and cook.

config_entry_id.name: Instance
config_entry_id.description: The drauf instance to query. Only needed when several are set up.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day of the range. When omitted, the range starts at the most recent start day (or today).

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day of the range (inclusive). When omitted, the range covers the number of days.

start_day.name: Start day
start_day.description: Weekday the plan week starts with; the range starts at its most recent occurrence. A Friday-to-Friday week is start day Friday with 8 days.

week_offset.name: Week offset
week_offset.description: Shift the range by whole weeks, e.g. 1 for next week.

days.name: Days
days.description: Length of the range in days (default 7).
